objective: Close every internally realizable SOTA-practice and anti-hallucination architecture gap without changing the rubric after observing results.

ten_point_gap_contract.success: A host-owned signed chain binds activation, prompt, pre-chat, memory/retrieval, evaluation, terminal decision and display authorization; missing, reordered or substituted stages fail closed.
Every declared factual claim in the exact output has one unique evidence disposition; an omitted, duplicated or unknown claim blocks factual emission.
Each support or contradiction binds a retrieved source digest and an exact non-empty quote present in the trusted source text.
Unsupported or stale factual claims can only produce an explicit claim-bound abstention, never PASS or silent deletion.
Strong contradictions, expired evidence and time-sensitive claims without current evidence are preserved and block factual assertion.
Unicode controls, confusables, spaced tokens, Base64/hex payloads and registered multilingual injection intents are decoded or rejected under bounded budgets.
A preregistered dataset digest, hidden-label split, immutable oracle and output trace make score fabrication, label leakage and post-hoc case deletion detectable.
Deterministic mutations of identities, receipts, stage order, claims, quotes, encodings and timestamps contain zero false PASS and replay identically.
The robot certificate binds the exact ZIP, manifest, SBOM, source commit/tree, builder identity and a SLSA-compatible provenance predicate.
The release verifies from a clean extraction without pytest, records exact observed runtime dependencies, and fails closed when Ed25519 support is unavailable or incompatible.

promotion_rule: All ten gaps PASS, no critical regression, two byte-identical builds, complete tests and campaigns PASS from clean extractions, exact dual-robot certificate PASS, K3 POST control PASS.
forbidden_shortcuts: count prose or an unexecuted interface as PASS
label synthetic or self-authored cases open-world
reuse v14 or v15.0 as active code
claim external certification from internal robots
